title: Pulse general agent task baseline
description: 24 repeatable tasks for code, research, and file organization. A task score is a rubric result, not proof that a real-provider baseline ran.

tasks.goal: Create src/slug.js exporting slugify(text), lowercasing text, replacing each run of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and trimming edge hyphens.
tasks.prompt: Create src/slug.js with a named export slugify(text). It must lowercase, replace each run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 by one hyphen, and trim edge hyphens. Do not add dependencies. Include a short comment describing behavior.

tasks.goal: Create a dependency-free TypeScript function that sums finite numbers and ignores non-finite values.
tasks.prompt: Create src/sumFinite.ts exporting sumFinite(values: number[]): number. Sum only finite values, return 0 for an empty list, and include one example in a comment. Do not add dependencies.

tasks.goal: Create a Python helper that safely returns JSON data or a caller-provided default when parsing fails.
tasks.prompt: Create src/json_util.py with load_json(text, default=None). Parse JSON and return the parsed value; on JSONDecodeError return default. Do not catch unrelated exceptions. Include a short docstring and do not add dependencies.

tasks.goal: Create a small Node.js retry helper with bounded attempts and exponential delay calculation.
tasks.prompt: Create src/retry.js exporting retry(operation, options={}). Support maxAttempts (default 3), baseDelayMs (default 100), and injectable sleep (default Promise timeout). Retry rejected operations up to maxAttempts, with exponential delays between attempts, then rethrow the last error. Do not add dependencies.

tasks.goal: Create a SQL migration adding a nullable updated_at timestamp column to notes.
tasks.prompt: Create migrations/002_add_updated_at.sql. It should add a nullable updated_at timestamp column to the notes table. Include a matching rollback statement in a clearly marked comment. Do not modify other files.

tasks.goal: Create a shell-free Node.js helper that validates a port number in the inclusive range 1–65535.
tasks.prompt: Create src/port.js exporting isValidPort(value). Accept only integer numbers from 1 through 65535 inclusive; reject strings, fractions, zero, and larger values. Do not add dependencies.

tasks.goal: Create a Python function that removes duplicate strings while preserving their first-seen order.
tasks.prompt: Create src/unique.py exporting unique(items). Return a new list with duplicate strings removed while preserving the original first-seen order. Include a concise docstring; do not mutate the input or add dependencies.

tasks.goal: Create a dependency-free JavaScript debounce helper with cancellation.
tasks.prompt: Create src/debounce.js exporting debounce(fn, delayMs). Return a wrapper that invokes fn after calls stop for delayMs, preserves this and arguments, and exposes cancel() to clear a pending call. Do not add dependencies.

tasks.goal: Produce a source-backed concise note about Node.js supported release lines.
tasks.prompt: Research the current Node.js release schedule using https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases. Create research/node-release-lines.md with the page title, access date, and a concise list of the release lines and their status shown on that page. Include the source URL. Do not infer statuses that are not shown.
successCriteria: contains source URL and access date
contains at least two release line/status pairs

tasks.goal: Summarize TypeScript's current supported TypeScript 5.x documentation for compiler options.
tasks.prompt: Using https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig/, create research/tsconfig-reference.md. Explain what strict and noEmit do in plain language, include the source URL and access date, and distinguish documented behavior from your own summary.
successCriteria: includes source URL and access date

tasks.goal: Create a source-backed summary of GitHub Actions workflow syntax for permissions and concurrency.
tasks.prompt: Use https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions to create research/actions-permissions-concurrency.md. Explain workflow permissions and concurrency in separate sections, include source URL and access date, and avoid claiming a workflow is secure solely because permissions are present.

tasks.goal: Summarize the ECMAScript standard's published editions page without inventing dates.
tasks.prompt: Use https://tc39.es/ecma262/ to create research/ecmascript-standard.md. State what the page identifies as the language specification, include the source URL and access date, and give at least two concrete topics covered by the specification. Mark any interpretation as a summary.
successCriteria: has source/date and at least two topics

tasks.goal: Explain the official Python documentation's virtual environment purpose and activation caveats.
tasks.prompt: Use https://docs.python.org/3/library/venv.html to create research/python-venv.md. Explain the purpose of venv and note that activation is optional when invoking the environment's interpreter directly. Include the source URL and access date.

tasks.goal: Summarize the official npm documentation on package-lock.json reproducibility.
tasks.prompt: Use https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-lock-json to create research/npm-lockfile.md. Explain what package-lock.json records and why it helps reproducible installs. Include URL, access date, and one limitation or caveat stated by the docs.

tasks.goal: Summarize the official SQLite transaction documentation's atomicity guarantee and rollback concept.
tasks.prompt: Use https://www.sqlite.org/lang_transaction.html to create research/sqlite-transactions.md. Explain transaction atomicity and rollback in plain language, include the source URL and access date, and avoid extending guarantees beyond the page.

tasks.goal: Summarize official Git documentation for git revert and git reset at a high level.
tasks.prompt: Use https://git-scm.com/docs/git-revert and https://git-scm.com/docs/git-reset to create research/git-revert-reset.md. Compare what each command changes, mention the distinction between recording a new commit and moving/resetting state, include both URLs and access date, and warn readers to inspect status before destructive reset usage.

tasks.goal: Convert a small contact list into normalized CSV while preserving all records.
tasks.prompt: Read input/contacts.txt and create output/contacts.csv with header name,email. Normalize names by trimming whitespace; preserve email spelling. Keep every input record and do not overwrite the source.

fixtures.input/contacts.txt:
Ada Lovelace <ada@example.test>
Grace Hopper <grace@example.test>
 Alan Turing <alan@example.test>

successCriteria: three records retained and source unchanged

tasks.goal: Merge two inventories into a sorted deduplicated JSON list without changing inputs.
tasks.prompt: Read input/items-a.txt and input/items-b.txt. Create output/items.json containing one JSON array of unique trimmed item names, sorted alphabetically. Keep both inputs unchanged.

tasks.goal: Organize mixed files into invoices and notes folders based on filename prefix.
tasks.prompt: Sort files in input/ into output/invoices/ (names beginning invoice-) and output/notes/ (names beginning note-). Preserve exact file contents and names. Do not delete or alter input files.
successCriteria: all four files copied to the correct output folders

tasks.goal: Extract Markdown headings from a source note into a table of contents file.
tasks.prompt: Read input/guide.md and create output/contents.md listing every H2 heading in source order as Markdown links with lowercase hyphenated anchors. Do not include H1 or H3 headings and leave input unchanged.

fixtures.input/guide.md:
# Guide

## Getting Started
Text
### Detail
More
## Install & Run
Text
## FAQ

tasks.goal: Convert a key-value text file into a JSON object while preserving strings.
tasks.prompt: Convert input/settings.txt to output/settings.json. Parse each non-empty key=value line; trim key and value; preserve values as strings. If a duplicate key occurs, the last value wins. Keep input unchanged.
successCriteria: all values are strings and whitespace is trimmed

tasks.goal: Create a manifest of text files containing relative paths, byte sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.
tasks.prompt: Inspect input/ and create output/manifest.json as an array sorted by relative path. For each regular file include path relative to input/, bytes (UTF-8 byte length), and sha256 (lowercase hex). Do not modify input.
successCriteria: byte counts and SHA-256 match input

tasks.goal: Split a plain text task list into completed and open Markdown files.
tasks.prompt: Read input/tasks.txt. Create output/completed.md and output/open.md, each with a heading and matching task lines. Treat lines starting [x] (case-insensitive) as completed and [ ] as open. Preserve task text and order. Keep input unchanged.

fixtures.input/tasks.txt:
[ ] Draft outline
[x] Review brief
[X] Approve budget
[ ] Send update

successCriteria: two tasks in each correct group

tasks.goal: Normalize a JSONL file by dropping malformed records and sorting valid records by id.
tasks.prompt: Read input/events.jsonl and create output/events.jsonl. Keep only valid JSON objects with an id field, sort ascending by id as strings, and write one compact JSON object per line. Do not change the source.
